caption: A large printed exhibition panel carries a colour-coded historical map of ancient china, photographed slightly off-square in a dim room so that the dark red border frames it unevenly and glare washes the lower left. the white headline 春秋时期列国形势图 sits at the top left of a deep red banner, with a block of small white chinese text to its right beginning 公元前770年. the map beneath tints each state a different flat colour: 秦国 in orange across the west, 晋国 in pale grey-green to its north-east, 楚国 in olive yellow spanning the south, 齐国 in sand at the east, a small crimson 周国 near the centre, and blocks labelled 鲁国, 宋国, 郑国, 蔡国, 陈国, 徐国, 吴国, 越国, 燕国, 中山国, 蜀国 and 巴国 around them, with 西戎 and 林胡部落 in the pale north-west. thin blue river lines and dense small place names thread the whole surface. a vertical white column of characters at the right reads 新郑郑国贵族墓地分布图, beside an inset line-drawn street plan on white.

A young batter in a navy hooded sweatshirt, grey pants and a black helmet swings from the left side of home plate as a white baseball hangs in the air just past him, photographed from behind the backstop so blurred diagonal shadows of the fence mesh stripe the dirt across the foreground. a catcher in a red jersey and grey pants crouches at the right edge in mask, chest protector and shin guards with a black mitt extended, his shoulder lettering and number cut off by the frame. on the left a man in a dark hooded pullover and black cap follows through after delivering the pitch, and a child in a red jersey stands beyond him on the infield. packed orange dirt chalked with white lines gives way to patchy grass, a padded outfield fence hung with rectangular sponsor banners whose small print and phone numbers stay illegible, and a blue-roofed press box with a spectator deck on the right. tall pines and bare hardwoods close the background under flat grey light.

Two riders on grey-white horses work a small herd of dark, long-horned cattle across a dry pasture, photographed from a distance with a long lens so that a foreground wire fence of rough wooden posts crosses the whole frame in soft blur. the rider on the right wears a wide-brimmed black hat, a grey long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans, sitting upright on a stocky white horse that walks to the left with its head up. the second rider, further back at centre-left, wears sunglasses, a dark jacket over a bright yellow sleeve and pale trousers, and carries a long pale stick angled forward while the mount trots with one foreleg lifted. three or four bulls and cows with pale muzzles, mottled grey-brown hides and upswept horns move left along the fence line at the far left edge. behind them a second post-and-wire fence and a band of bare deciduous trees mixed with a dark evergreen fill the upper half, lit from the side by low sun that picks out golden dry grass. a grey watermark reading apnphotographie photographe www.apnphotographe.com sits in the lower right corner.

Three people sit shoulder to shoulder on a brown crushed-velvet sofa against a plain beige wall, lit by a hard direct flash that carves crisp shadows behind them and blows out skin highlights. in the centre a woman with straight shoulder-length black hair smiles wide at the camera, wearing a black and gold vertically striped slip dress with thin straps and a tied bust, dangling red earrings, a ring, and bright red nail polish on hands folded over her crossed legs; a small black studded handbag rests against her thigh. on the left a man with short greying spiked hair and stubble leans in with one arm stretched along the sofa back behind her, wearing a charcoal t-shirt printed in black with play again inside a rectangular outline, ripped black jeans and a black knee brace, with tattoos on his forearm. on the right a man in an all-black long-sleeved shirt and black tie tips his head toward her and holds a green glass beer bottle with a red-and-white label low in his lap, one knee showing through torn black jeans. a cream light switch and a white power socket punctuate the wall behind, and folded white towels sit on the sofa arm at the far left.

A bride sits sideways on a broad windowsill in a black-and-white photograph, turned in near profile toward the bright louvred window at the right, chin lifted and eyes closed in a wide open smile. her dark hair is pinned up and a long sheer veil drapes over the crown of her head, falling down her back and pooling in the folds of her dress. the gown is a one-shouldered column with a beaded strap at the left shoulder, ruched across the bodice and gathered into deep soft folds over her lap and legs. her right hand rests flat on the marble sill at the lower right of the frame with a lace cuff at the wrist, while her left arm braces behind her on the ledge. horizontal glass louvres and a heavy dark window latch pattern the background with strong parallel bands of blown highlight, and wooden shutters frame the left and right edges. a watermark reading fabriziofedericofotografo sits in the lower right corner.

A basketball player drives up a polished maple court, caught mid-stride with both hands cupping an orange ball at chest height and his head turned to look ahead to the right. he wears a black sleeveless jersey with purple shoulder trim and light outlined lettering arched across the chest that his own arm and the ball obscure past reading, black shorts with a white and purple side stripe and a small purple bird logo on the left leg, white ankle socks and black-and-white low-top sneakers. his dark hair is thick and windswept and his mouth is set in concentration. another player in black crosses the right edge in motion blur, only legs and white-soled shoes within the frame. a navy padded wall runs across the background beneath rows of empty blue folding bleacher seats and a stair rail, and large cream key markings and a dark sideline stripe cut across the varnished floorboards, which reflect the players in soft streaks. the panning exposure keeps the driving player sharp while smearing the floor grain and background, and the cool blue and purple palette is broken only by the ball and the warm wood.

A two-and-a-half-storey red brick house stands three-quarters on to the camera in bright winter sun, its front corner pointing at the viewer and its roofline framed against a deep, cloudless blue sky. a gabled dormer with a wide multi-pane window caps the front, sitting above a heavy cream cornice carried on a long row of blocky brackets, and a tall brick chimney rises at the left. the porch roof below is trimmed in sage green with painted swag decoration on its fascia, supported by square columns, and it shelters a white front door reached by a straight run of stone steps with white railings; a white balustrade encloses the porch above a rendered stone foundation. a black metal fire escape zigzags down the left side wall past shuttered basement openings, and a green rubbish bin sits on the drive at the lower left. to the right a white-painted brick house with dark green shutters, a hipped dormer and a striped awning stands close by, with another red brick facade beyond it. trampled snow covers the lawn and pavement, and bare branches and a dark garage intrude at the far left.

A canal glides past the open side of a passenger excursion boat, photographed from a seat near the rail so the white superstructure and a bright red gunwale stripe slice diagonally from the lower left toward the centre. the boat's white painted columns, panelled bulkhead and rolled canvas awning frame the left half, and along a bench beneath them sit several passengers in profile: a woman in a floral-print blouse with a lanyard nearest the camera, another in a pale grey top with a patterned shoulder bag, a woman in green, and a man in a dark shirt further back, all facing forward toward the water. a man in a dark cap stands at the far end near an open doorway. beyond the rail the canal spreads flat and glassy, its dark green surface holding mirror reflections of the trees on the far bank and of pale streaked cloud. a mown grass embankment runs along the right side to a broad-crowned tree, and a small white footbridge and low buildings close the perspective in the distance under a soft blue sky. shadowed interior tones on the left contrast with the bright open water at right.

Two trail runners climb a narrow track worn through steep grassy pasture, photographed from a low eye-level position ahead of them in a wide letterbox crop. the leading man wears a purple and white technical singlet with small sponsor lettering across the chest, black shorts, a white cap and a race bib printed "428", a dark moustache and a grimace of effort as he pushes up the slope; a grey compression sleeve with vertical lettering covers his left calf above orange-soled shoes. the runner to his right wears a turquoise and black hydration vest over a matching short-sleeved top, black shorts, a wrist watch and bib "476", arms swinging as he keeps pace. behind them a third competitor in a blue vest descends the same line, and a cluster of spectators in shorts and running kit stands on the grassy shoulder at upper left near a low stone marker. tall seed-heavy grass and yellow wildflowers fill the left foreground, while ridge after ridge of green hills recedes into blue haze with a low bank of cloud pooling in a valley. bright overhead sun, a clear pale sky, and the white flank and mud tyre of a vehicle intruding at the right edge complete the frame.
